question: The Japfu range, which is 3,014 meters high, is located in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Japfu range:-**

 
 
• It is located in **Nagaland**, which is one of the **Northeastern states of India.**
 
• The range is situated near the town of** Kohima**, which is the capital city of Nagaland.
 
• Japfu peak is the **highest point in the range**, and it offers a breathtaking view of the surrounding valleys and hills.
 
• The range is known for its** rich biodiversity** and is home to many rare and endangered species of plants and animals. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Assam** is a neighboring state of Nagaland, located towards the west.

 
 
• It is known for its tea plantations, wildlife sanctuaries, and historical sites.
 
 
 
• **Arunachal Pradesh** is another neighboring state of Nagaland, located towards the east.
 
 
• It is known for its scenic beauty, diverse culture, and adventure activities like trekking and rafting.
 
 
 
• **Meghalaya** is a state located southwest of Nagaland.
 
 
• It is known for its beautiful waterfalls, caves, and living root bridges.
